## Question 1 (10-points)

Install the aRtsy package. Show the code used to install the aRtsy package, but turn off the code chunk so it doesn't evaluate.

Explain the difference between install.packages and library

```{r}
library(aRtsy)

set.seed(1)

canvas_collatz(
  colors = c("blue", "purple", "orange"),
  n = 1:3
)

canvas_collatz(
  colors = "blue",
  n = 1:20 # Can also be a vector of numbers to use as starting numbers.
)
```

## Question 2 (10-points)
